notes.title: New features are coming!
notes.content:
Hi, here's a list of some new features that I plan to add in the coming weeks:

- ability to open/close some doors to slow down the chase
- lockers/drawers that will be containers for random located items
- stun gun to incapacitate mutants for a short period of time
- enriching the environment with new elements
- additional items/actions necessary to win the game

Cheers!
